title: Towing and Labor Coverage Endorsement: Insuring Agreement and Covered Services
content:
**Towing and Labor Coverage** provides one coverage part, towing and labor, for the vehicle to which it is attached. The terms in this section are the same on every package of the Cardinal Point Towing and Labor family ($50, $75, $100, $125, $150 and $200).

## A. Covered services

The services paid under the coverage are:

1. tow;
2. jump-start;
3. lockout;
4. flat tire change;
5. fuel delivery;
6. winch-out.

## B. Labor

Labor is paid only at the place of disablement. The most labor time paid at the place of disablement is 60 minutes; labor beyond 60 minutes is not paid.

## C. Tow destination

A tow is paid to the nearest qualified repair facility, or to a facility the insured chooses within the limit.

## D. Winching

Winching is paid only where the vehicle is within 100 feet of a paved road; 100 feet is the farthest distance from a paved road for which winching is paid.

## E. Costs not paid as part of a service

1. **Fuel.** The cost of the fuel itself is not paid; fuel delivery covers the delivery service only.
2. **Parts.** Parts, such as batteries, tires and keys, are not paid.
3. **Key cutting.** Key cutting or programming is not paid; lockout covers opening the vehicle only.
4. **Storage.** Storage after a tow is not paid.

## F. Territory

Service is provided in the United States and Canada.

## Summary across packages

| Term | All six packages |
|---|---|
| Coverage part | Towing and labor |
| Covered services | Tow, jump-start, lockout, flat tire change, fuel delivery, winch-out |
| Where labor is paid | Only at the place of disablement |
| Most labor time paid | 60 minutes; labor beyond it not paid |
| Tow paid to | Nearest qualified repair facility, or a facility the insured chooses within the limit |
| Farthest winching distance from a paved road | 100 feet |
| Cost of fuel itself | Not paid (delivery service only) |
| Parts (batteries, tires, keys) | Not paid |
| Key cutting or programming | Not paid (lockout opening only) |
| Storage after a tow | Not paid |
| Territory | United States and Canada |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A vehicle stuck 80 feet from a paved road is within the winching distance, and winching is paid; one stuck 150 feet from a paved road is beyond it, and winching is not paid.
- Labor of 90 minutes performed at the place of disablement: 60 minutes are paid and the 30 minutes beyond are not.
- Labor performed at a repair facility after a tow is not at the place of disablement, and is not paid.
- A fuel delivery: the delivery service is paid; the fuel delivered is not.
- A lockout on a vehicle whose key is lost: opening the vehicle is paid; cutting or programming a new key is not.
